{{TCWRetcon}}
[[File:Tattooing.jpg|thumb|250x|right|[[Deliah Blue]] tattooing a black skull on [[Cade Skywalker]]'s arm.]]
{{Quote|Please tell me that all that stuff will wash out of your hair.''"<br />"''It will. But the tattoos are permanent.''"<br />"''Tattoos?|[[Myri Antilles]] startling [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|her father]]|<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>}}
A '''tattoo''' was a permanent insertion of ink<ref name="YJK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref><ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> or pigments<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> below the skin using a sharp needle.<ref name="YJK" /> A number of beings had tattoos, normally for cosmetic reasons or as part of their culture or an organization.

Tattooing was also used as a common identification or branding of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. One example was the slave trade planet [[Orvax IV]]. The [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Mezgraf]], a former slave of this planet, had his slaver's mark on his right shoulder, still visible through his white fur, and would often wear a long-sleeved jacket to cover it.<ref name="Dark Times 3">[[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]]</ref>

A tattooist, or tattoo artist, was a person who drew tattoos on people's skin as a job. Notable examples were [[Bojam Rees]], who made a living as a tattooist on [[Starstation 12]],<ref name="BFEE">''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire]]''</ref> and the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lafrarian]] [[Nuyu]], a tattoo artist and body decorator who ran a small shop on [[StarForge Station]].<ref name="The Far Orbit Project">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> The [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] capital [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] hosted a high proportion of tattoo parlors.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref><ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], under the direction of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were encouraged to adopt their own individual identities. They distinguished themsemselves from each other by choosing nicknames for themselves, getting tattoos, customizing [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|their armor]] and their [[Hair/Legends|hairstyles]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

"[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] Tattoo" was shipjacker slang for "price on your head" ([[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] level).<ref name="Special Ops: Ship Jackers">''"Shipjacker slang"'' in {{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref> Tattoos could be concealed with [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]].<ref name="Key">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

==Notable cultures==
===A'mari===
The [[A'mari]] were the former ruling clan of [[Malano III]]. They were marked with a black tattoo across their neck.<ref name="Rebel Force: Target">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref>

===Aquellans===
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquella]] was notable for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]]' ritual tattooing and dyeing on their bodies upon reaching adulthood.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A combination of permanent dye and micro-tattooing was applied during rite of passage ceremonies, and the resulting purplish-green skin made them look like a race of [[Near-Human]]s.<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===Bk'trugh clan===
The [[Clan Bk'trugh|Bk'trugh clan]] was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan whose members could be recognized by a tattoo on their arms.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]] {{C|''Chapter Two: Gamemastering''}}</ref>

[[File:KoVakier-tattoos.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The [[Blood Carver]] [[Ko Vakier]] with tattoos on his nose flaps.]]

===Blood Carvers===
The [[Blood Carver]]s sported tribal tattoos along the ridge of their nose flaps.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

===Bomu Clan===
{{Quote|I know the clan. Bomu family. I recognize the facial tattoos.|[[Reen Irana]]|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
The [[Bomu Clan]] was an extended family of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Each member was marked with a tattoo of the clan's family symbol as soon as she or he was old enough to hold a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] carbine.<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>

===Bosphs===
The [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] stood out from other tattooed cultures by their unusual motif: [[Star/Legends|star]] maps. The first Bosphs were nomads, and would often tattoo themselves with maps and star charts for navigation. This tradition is still practiced by high-ranking officials and many non-ranking Bosphs. When the species was discovered by scouts several decades before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Bosphs who took to the stars developed the tradition further by having their skin adorned with intricate star maps, which often depicted [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]] not yet discovered by even professional scouts.<ref name="Alien Encounters article series">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>

===Dantari===
Seven years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], refugees from [[Eol Sha]] made a new home on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the homeworld of the [[Dantari]], only to be wiped out by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]. To the primitive Dantari, the arrival of Daala's forces was an event of unprecedented awe, and they began incorporating Imperial symbology into their belief systems. As part the new tradition, the Dantari tattooed themselves with Imperial symbols; Imperial crests, [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and in the case of the truly brave, full body depictions of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="UAA" />

===Duhma===
The [[Duhma]] [[Species/Legends|species]] identified themselves through their tribal tattoos of a unique pattern. The former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Abal Karda]] had his face tattooed with their symbol, as part of a disguise to avoid being captured for the bounty placed on his head.<ref name="BFEE" />

===Ebranite===
The [[Ebranite]] social structures were based on family and clan units. Each clan, or ''thilda'', had a unique identifying insignia. This insignia was a source of pride and honor, and any insult directed to the clan insignia was viewed as an insult to the clan itself, and to each and every clan member of that clan. Every Ebranite had their clan's insignia tattooed on the uppermost left arm at birth, and remained loyal to their respective clans until death.

In the past millennia, the Ebranite society was plagued with clan warfare, but as their society slowly evolved, many clans would cooperate for mutual advancement. It became increasingly more common to find several clans living together, and children were now given a new clan insignia symbolizing the unity of several clans.<ref name="UAA" /><ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

===Falleen===
Some groups of [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] had clan or loyalty tattoos on their bodies.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>

===Gorothite===
The [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] had several wattles beneath their chins, which they decorated with complex, helical tattoos of bright color. The tattoos denoted ancestry and status within their society, and also identified to which ''j'ber'' (a kind of clan or extended family) an individual belonged. Most Gorothite couldn't understand how offworlder could be insensitive to these fine gradations of status.<ref name="Goroth: Slave of the Empire">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Quinlan-tattoos.jpg|thumb|right|175px|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] with yellow [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] tattoos on his face and left arm.]]

===Gree===
The [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] decorated their long foreheads with hieroglyphic tattoos which indicated rank and caste.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>

===Kiffar===
{{Quote|My source tells me that she's about fifty, has a Kiffar facial tattoo, and flies a KDY assault ship that I think you'd recognize.''"|[[Goran Beviin]], on Kiffar [[Ailyn Vel]]|<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>}}
The [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]] and the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] stood out from other [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Near-Human]]s by their tattoos. The Kiffar believed that it is the mother who gives life, and the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] flows through her to her children. As part of this belief, the tattoos of the Kiffar<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>—known as qukuuf<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>—signified their family heritage from their mothers.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Various patterns, designs and colors identify an individual's clan. Known colors were yellow, like the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], green, like [[Kiffu Guardians|Kiffu Guardian]] [[Asanté Vos]],<ref name="Twilight">''[[Star Wars: Twilight]]''</ref> purple, like Guardian [[Horsea]],<ref name="Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref> black, like [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Sintas Vel|Sintas]] and [[Ailyn Vel]]<ref name="Bloodlines" /> and former [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Republic trooper]] [[Larin Moxla]],<ref name="Fatal">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> red, like Guardian [[Vanlin]],<ref name="Darkness" /> and blue, like [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]].<ref name="Fatal" />

When an individual's mother was not a Kiffar, apparently the father's tattoos were taken on; this was the case of [[Korto Vos]], the son of Quinlan Vos and [[Human/Legends|Human]] mother [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]].<ref name="HE">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref>

===Mirialans===
{{Quote|Luminara, [we] have had a recent encounter with someone who bears markings similar to yours.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]] had a religious belief<ref name="NEGAS" /><ref name="PJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> based on an ancient,<ref name="NEGAS" /> primitive understanding of the [[Unifying Force/Legends|Unifying Force]], and believed that an individual's actions contributes to her or his destiny.<ref name="PJS" /> Their actions encompass a long and specific list of tests of skill and character. The Mirialans tattooed themselves with geometric tattoos<ref name="Mirialan">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|mirialan|Mirialan}}</ref> on their faces and hands, sometimes on their arms, legs, feet and shoulders. The specific patterns told other Mirialans what tests an individual had undertaken successfully, and what general part she or he would take in the future of the Mirialans,<ref name="PJS" /> as well as that individuals importance to the future of the universe.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[File:LuminaraTattoos-DaG.png|thumb|left|260px|Luminara Unduli with Mirialan tattoos on her face and knuckle joints.]]
The shapes and locations of Mirialan tattoos denoted different actions in the life of the Mirialan, and upon [[Death/Legends|death]], the markings were used to determine the cultural worth of the individual and their contributions to furthering the culture as a whole.<ref name="Mirialan" /> Each shape and line depicted the Mirialan's personal history, but few other [[Species/Legends|species]] cared to decipher them.<ref name="Old">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] wore unique tattoos to signify that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] had singled them out for greater destinies. Luminara's tattoos included her lower lip, her chin and the knuckle joints on her hands.<ref name="PJS" /> Her lower lip had a purplish-black color, and her chin was adorned with interlocking black diamond-shaped tattoos, while more intricate markings covered her knuckle joints.<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> Later, she had her upper lip tattooed as well, and her chin-tattoo was enlarged with more diamonds.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref>

Barriss' tattoos were not as detailed as her master's, but she knew that she would acquire more of them as she grew older. Her diamond-shaped tattoos<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> ran across her cheeks, the bridge of her nose, and the backs of her hands.<ref name="PJS" /> Her lips were the same dark color of the tattoos,<ref name="AOTC" /> but it is uncertain whether they were tattooed as well, or were just make-up.

The male Mirialan [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]] was rushed from temple to temple with small diamond-shaped tattoos.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

The Mirialan [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Baasen Ray]] had tattoos on his chin and cheeks. He acquired a few more as he got older.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>

===Nightbrothers===
{{Quote|Who applied the markings?''"<br />"''The mother did.''"|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] discussing [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="DP" />}}
[[File:Nightbrothers.png|thumb|right|320px|Zabrak Nightbrothers]]
The [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] were a tribal group of [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] ([[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]]) [[Gender/Legends|men]] subservient to the Nightsisters of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="I122">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> Shortly after birth, a Nightbrother was subjected to an initiation ritual in which he was submerged in an oily bath, energized with [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]] conjured by the Nightsisters' use of [[Magic/Legends|magicks]], and covered with tattoos<ref name="DP" /> on their chests and faces.<ref name="Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Sometimes, the tattoos were applied to the Nightbrother's entire body - this was the case with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="DP" /> The Nightbrothers' tattoos marked them as the Nightsisters' kin and warriors,<ref name="Sith" /> and also showed which Nightbrother clan they belonged to.<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref><ref name="Sith" />

Maul was a member of the Nightbrothers before being taken by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to be trained as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="I122" /><ref name="DP" /> Maul's tattoos, thought to be linked to the Sith, actually came from the warrior culture of the Nightbrothers.<ref name="I122" /><ref name="DP" /> His entire body had been garishly and ceremonially tattooed in red and black pigments by [[Kycina|his mother]] when he was less than a standard year of age (before he was taken by Sidious),<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] - Note: Maul's ''skin'' is depicted as red in "[[Marked]]," and he is referred to as "red-skinned" with "black tattoos" in ''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''; but ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' (Sith tattoos) and [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] (Nightbrother tattoos) establish that the tattoos were black ''and'' red; in addition, both ''Marked'' and [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] claim that [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] himself applied the tattoos, and ''Star Wars: Darth Plagueis'' describes Sidious informing Plagueis of the tattoos' Nightbrother heritage.</ref> symbols which showed his Nightbrother heritage.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Later stripped of his black Nightbrother markings, Maul was left solely red-skinned. Agonizing Sith Tatoos were applied personally by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] in an attempt to cleanse Maul's mind.<ref name="Marked">{{Tales|24|Marked}}</ref><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] also wore tattoos.<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>

===Nightsisters===
The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] had a tradition of facial tattooing. The markings announced to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] what they were.<ref name="Sith" /> One example was a group of Nightsisters lead by matriarch [[Zalem/Legends|Zalem]]. The coven had pale skin with black tattoos.<ref>''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''; confirmed as tattoos in {{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> The Nightsister [[Robetheri]] wore reddish-brown tattoos on her bald head and face, which drastically altered her appearance.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Sometimes, the markings on a Nightsister's face were not tattoos, but bruises. According a text written by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], channeling the magic of the [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]] could burst minor [[Blood/Legends|blood]] vessels, raising telltale bruises on the cheeks and around the eyes.<ref name="Sith" /> Talzin's herself had such permanent bruises on her face as a result of the use of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] powers.<ref>''[[Restraint]]'' (Note that ''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]'' refers to [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] facial markings as tattoos)</ref>

===Pantorans===
The blue-skinned [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] wore yellow tattoos on their faces.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>

===Rattataki===
The [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] were distinguished by their chalk-white skin, and facial tattoos.<ref name="Old" />

===Scipioans===
Tattoos were mark of status on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], a [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] member from Scipio, wore yellow tattoos on his forehead.<ref name="CWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Sharu===
After the [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]] of [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] was activated, the life-energies of the Sharu were awakened from their computerized slumber, and the Toka, the species' temporary, primitive form, were restored to the Sharu. Many of the new Sharu had tattoos on their foreheads of the Mindharp or other Sharu symbols.<ref name="A Campaign Guide to the Centrality">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

===Sleheyroni===
[[File:Ziro-SWE.png|thumb|right|220px|[[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with the tattoos of the Hutts of [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] on his head, back, arms and tail. He also had the symbol of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] tattooed on his belly.]]

The wealthy [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] of [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]], a Hutt trade world, wore unique headdresses, jewelry and golden [[Sleheyroni tattoo|tattoos]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt got his tattoos during his younger days as a crime lord and smuggling boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> His tattoos were inked by a Sleheyroni artist. He also had the symbol of his [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] faction tattooed on his belly.<ref name="CWCE" />

===Sullustans===
Each [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan's]] cranial markings and dew flaps were as unique to that individual as a retinal marker or fingerprints. Some Sullustans took this uniqueness a step further by adding ritual tattoos, reinforcing their individualism.<ref name="NEGAS" /> One example of a tattooed Sullustan was a Sullustan member of the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] met a Sullustan in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Kiamurr]], who had ornate tattoos on his dewflaps and ears.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />

===Tarasin===
The [[Tarasin]] had a tattoo design unique to their species: A [[kir'ala]] tree with its long, weeping branches. Color-changing inks were reserved for marks of true honor.<ref name="Sacrifices">''[[Sacrifices]]'' [http://www.wizards.com/default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040812]</ref>

===Tusken Raiders===
{{Quote|I marked myself to set myself apart. So that, under my outer face, I would not have to be...Human|[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]]|<ref name="R59" />}}
[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] wore ritual tattoos on their bodies.<ref name="I113">{{InsiderCite|113|Dark Forces: The Villains of Star Wars|Dark Forces: The Villains of ''Star Wars''}}</ref> [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] raised among Tuskens, wore the tattoos of his people<ref name="I113">{{InsiderCite|113|Dark Forces: The Villains of Star Wars|Dark Forces: The Villains of ''Star Wars''}}</ref> on his face<ref name="R59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref> and shoulders<ref name="Siege">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref>. The black markings were a way of identifing himself as not being human under his Tusken trappings.<ref name="R59" />

[[File:MasterShaperLegacy11.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Nei Rin]] with [[Yuuzhan Vong]] tattoos.]]

===Yuuzhan Vong===
{{Quote|Tattooed head to toe, and soon to be black with blood, if we have anything to say about it.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Garray]], on a Yuuzhan Vong [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]|<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
Among the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], tattooing was part of a religious ritual of reshaping and disfiguration. Most Yuuzhan Vong bore severe disfigurements, scars and tattoos to more closely resemble their [[Deity/Legends|gods]], which they fanatically worshiped.<ref>''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

===Wroonians===
The [[Near-Human]], blue-skinned [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonians]]<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> often wore ornate markings on their faces, but it is unclear how often these facial decorations were tattoos, instead of make-up or paint. The Wroonian woman [[Azoora]] had her forehead decorated with a yellow mark that matched her lips.<ref>[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]] and ''[[The Starhoppers of Aduba-3]]'' article in [[Star Wars Gamer 4|''Star Wars Gamer'' 4]]</ref> [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]], the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Wroona/Legends|Wroonian homeworld]],<ref name="DB-Eekway, Chi">{{DB|character|chieekway|Eekway, Chi}}</ref> whose skin color matched the Wroonians, wore black markings on her forehead, nose and chin.<ref>{{Film|III}} and ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'' (pictures only)</ref> The planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] was home to several offworld cultures, including Wroonians.<ref name="DB-Saleucami">{{DB|location|saleucami|Saleucami}}</ref> Among the Wroonian colonists, ornate facial markings appeared to be common. At least two colors, red and black, existed.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

===Zabrak===
The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] wore facial tattoos made up of thin lines that they received during their rite of passage, which takes place after their horns begin to grow at puberty. These facial marks could be symbolic of many things, like family lineage or where they came from, or could be a personal design of their own.<ref name="NEGAS" /> A Zabrak's ritual tattoos were unique to each Zabrak, and could represent any number of things in their life or culture.<ref name="Old" /> The Sith Lord Darth Maul had his skin covered in black tattoos<ref name="NEGAS" /> from his Nightbrothers tribe.<ref name="I122">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> It was unusual for a Zabrak to have no facial tattoos<ref name="Street">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>; notable examples were [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Pol Haus]], [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|prefect]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]]<ref name="Street" /> and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Maris Brood]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed comic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed'' comic]]</ref>

==Notable organizations==
===Black Sun===
{{Quote|Those weren't Rebels, unless Rebels started wearing Black Sun tattoos...|[[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]]|<ref name="SS">{{GalaxyCite|10|Shadow Stalker}}</ref>}}
Some members of the crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] carried the symbol of the organization as a permanent tattoo on their body. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a trio of Black Sun [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] crossed paths with [[Nuru Kungurama]] and [[Breakout Squad]]. At least one of the mercenaries had a Black Sun tattoo on his forearm, though he covered it up with [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]].<ref name="Key" /> [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had the symbol of his Black Sun faction tattooed on his belly.<ref name="CWCE" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of Black Sun operatives attacked [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Lexhannen Torlock]]'s palace on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. The group was posing as members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but their Black Sun tattoos gave them away.<ref name="SS" /> In [[137 ABY]], several Black Sun members sought to extort protection money from [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]]. After the skirmish, a Black Sun tattoo could be seen on the shoulder a dead [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 23">[[Legacy (2006) 23|''Legacy'' (2006) 23]]</ref>

===The Crucible===
{{Quote|The marks! Don't you know what they are? Don't you know what she is?|[[Goethar Kleej]] about [[Jarael]]|<ref name="KOTOR41" />}}
[[File:JaraelTattoo-KotOR10.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Jarael]] with the [[Flames of the Crucible]] on her face and arms.]]
[[The Crucible]] was a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving ring]], whose minders wore tattoos<ref name="KOTOR45">[[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]]</ref> known as [[Flames of the Crucible]]<ref name="KOTOR41">[[Knights of the Old Republic 41|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 41]]</ref>. Some members, such as [[Chantique]] and [[Jarael]], were known to bear the Flames of the Crucible on their arms and faces.<ref name="KOTOR45">[[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]]</ref> Jarael had never explained her body art,<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> but in the end, her past caught up with her when she ran into a slave called [[Goethar Kleej]] on [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]<ref name="KOTOR41">[[Knights of the Old Republic 41|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 41]]</ref>. Goethar had never met her before, but recognized the markings printed on her face.<ref name="KOTOR41">[[Knights of the Old Republic 41|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 41]]</ref> However, the tattoos on Jarael's face spelled out her name, which in the ancient tongue of the Crucible<ref name="KOTOR45">[[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]]</ref> meant "protector", and had been given to her by the slaves she had tried to help as well as she could.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 46">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref>

===Duality===
The Duality was a popular and benign Tarrack cult founded on the twin principles of joy and service. Followers could be identified by the tattoos on their foreheads and cheeks.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

===Force Hounds===
{{Quote|A child...with the same tattoo as you. You as a child, Xesh? Yes.|[[Tasha Ryo]], looking into the mind of [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]|<ref name="Dawn05">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[Force Hound]]s were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] servants of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. They wore a tattoo of their [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter name on their face and body. The [[Near-Human]] [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] had a red tattoo on her face representing the letter [[Trill/Legends|Trill]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]] Force Hound [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] had blue tattoos on his face, back and arms, representing the letter [[Xesh/Legends|Xesh]]. [[Isk (Force Hound)|Isk]] had azure tattoos on his face and arm representing the letter [[Isk/Legends|Isk]].<ref name="Dawn04">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref>

===K'thri===
The followers of the [[K'thri]] martial arts had their mark tattooed on their skin.<ref name="Martial Arts">''[[Martial Arts]]'' [http://www.wizards.com/default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040415a]</ref>

===Matukai===
The [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] were an ancient sect of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When a member completed her or his training, that person tattooed themselves with a symbol that covered parts of their forehead and the sides of the face at the eyes.<ref name="Hero's Guide">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref> After the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], many Matukai joined the [[New Jedi Order]], but they still preferred to distinguish themselves with a facial tattoo.<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path'']]</ref>

===Rav's Pirates===
[[File:Jariah_Syn.jpg|thumb|left|155px|[[Jariah Syn]] with the [[Bloody Bones]] tattooed on his shoulder.]]
The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]] and his crew wore tattoos of the Rav's insignia called the [[Bloody Bones]], composed of two crossed red bones. His symbol was feared throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. After joining Rav's crew, [[Cade Skywalker]] was marked with Rav's insignia on his arm, but added a skull to his tattoo, thus making the symbol his own.<ref name="L0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> He would later add a similar, black tattoo on the other arm.<ref name="Legacy 2006 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>

Many members of Rav's crew wore other red tattoos in addition to Rav's symbol.<ref name="Legacy 2006 23">[[Legacy (2006) 23|''Legacy'' (2006) 23]]</ref> For example, Cade's friend and fellow pirate [[Jariah Syn]] had red markings tattooed on his right forearm, wrist and hand. Cade had a similar tattoo on his left forearm, reminiscent of a red anchor,<ref name="L">''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''</ref> as well as a red skull tattooed on his left leg.<ref name="Legacy 2006 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>

===Red Hand===
Several members of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] criminal organization [[Red Hand]] had their organization's symbol tattooed on their skin. At least two different color designs, red and purple, were used.<ref name="Life Below">{{CWACite|9|Life Below}}</ref>

===Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance===
The [[Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance]] were a religious group of [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]]
[[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. When traveling outside their temple, they wore full length robes and masks to hide the lines of scripture tattooed on their bodies.<ref name="DB-Nod, Seib">{{DB|character|seibnod|Nod, Seib}}</ref>

===Sith Order===
Several members of the [[Sith Order]] adorned themselves with black tattoos of various patterns and designs.

====Sith Empire====
{{Quote|Naga Sadow, are you ready for the mark?|A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] soldier to the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]|<ref name="TGAotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[XoXaan]], one of the first [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], had her face tattooed with black markings.<ref name="Legacy 2006 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>

The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] of the old [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] wore tattoos of rank on their foreheads. The burning venom of a kind of [[Sith pincerbug|pincerbug]] was used to burn the mark into the Dark Lords skin.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> Centuries later, the Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] would bear the same mark.<ref name="EGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> 1000 year after the fall of the Sith Empire, the spirit of the Dark Lord [[Marka Ragnos]] named [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] the newest Dark Lord, and made [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] Kun's apprentice. Marked with Sith tattoos on their foreheads by Ragnos' hand, the newest members of the Sith joined forces.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> When Ulic returned to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], his tattoo was carved away, leaving an x-shaped scar.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption]]''</ref>

The members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] did not wear tattoos. [[Seelah Korsin]] instilled in the tribe's [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] a "respect for their bodies" and a "lust for physical perfection". In her eyes, tattoos were labels for [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref> This tradition was still alive [[44 ABY|5000 years later]]: While the Lost Tribe enjoyed painting their bodies with decorative markings, they would never defile themselves with permanent ink.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

====Sith Empire (Jedi Civil War)====
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] a few decades later, the fallen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] founded a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|new Sith Empire]] and declared himself the new Dark Lord of the Sith. Several members of Revan's new Sith order sported tattoos. [[Uthar Wynn]], the head of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and his apprentice [[Yuthura Ban]] had parts of their heads and necks adorned with a detailed pattern of tattoos. Revan's follower [[Jorak Uln]] had his bald heads tattooed with a striped design.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>. However, Revan's apprentice, [[Darth Malak]], got his tattoos, blue stripes which adorned his head, before he became a Sith.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 31">[[Knights of the Old Republic 31|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 31]]</ref>

====Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)====
Many Sith of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had facial tattoos that represented their devotion to the Sith.<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>

[[Xat Hracken]] was the [[Combat Master]] at the [[Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]] in year [[3645 BBY]]. His upper body was hardened by scar tissue and strange tattoos.<ref name="Red Harvest novel">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>

====New Sith Empire====
In year [[1750 BBY]], the powerful Sith leader known only as the [[Dark Underlord]] consolidated a large Sith group known as the [[Black Knights]]. One of these knights was a [[Unidentified Zeltron Sith general|Zeltron commander]],<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> whose red skin was decorated with black tattoos on the left side of his face and bald head.<ref name="The History of the Mandalorians">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>

====New Sith Wars / Brotherhood of Darkness====
750 years later, by the time of the [[Ruusan campaign|battle]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], two and a half thousand years after Revan's time, the tattoos of the Sith had evolved into circles, wavy lines, straight lines, squares, spots, swirls, triangles etc. One example was the Sith Lord [[Githany]], who bore a wavy, circular black tattoo on her forehead. Several Sith of this era had their eyelids and skin around their eyes tattooed.<ref name="JS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> The Sith Lord [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the man who eventually reinvented the Sith order after its destruction and established the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] had black markings around his eyes,<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy">''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' covers</ref> Some Sith of this era wore tattoos on their head or face, though some had other parts of their body decorated.<ref name="JS" /> Among them was the Sith Lord [[Kas'im]], who wore his tattoos on his chest,<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> [[File:Talon-tattoos.jpg|thumb|right|170px|[[Darth Talon]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|New Sith Order]], had black Sith tattoos covering her body, head, and [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]]] and an unnamed [[Unidentified tattooed Sith|tattooed Sith]] who was tattooed on his head, face, neck and arms.<ref name="The Apprentice comic">{{Tales|17|The Apprentice (comic story)}}</ref>

[[Finn (Sith)|Finn]], a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] who operated as a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] during the final years of the [[New Sith Wars]],<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> had two black tattoos under each [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="The Apprentice comic">{{Tales|17|The Apprentice (comic story)}}</ref>

====Order of the Sith Lords====
Darth Bane's apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], eventually acquired facial markings similar to those of her master; again, is is not known whether these were permanent tattoos or simply painted. Zannah's apprentice, [[Darth Cognus]], already wore tattoos before she became a Sith - her chin was tattooed with four sharp, thin lines, extending like fangs from her lower lip.<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

[[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], the master of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], had esoteric body markings and tattoos on his body.<ref name="DP" />

[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] selected Darth Maul as his apprentice. Unbeknownst to many, Maul had been a member of the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] Nightbrothers before being taken away by Sidious, and Maul's full-body tattoos, thought to be linked to the Sith, initially came from the warrior culture of the Nightbrothers.<ref name="I122" /><ref name="DP" /> Maul's entire body had been garishly and ceremonially tattooed in red and black pigments before he was taken by Sidious, when Maul was less than a standard year of age.<ref name="DPN" /> Later stripped of his black Nightbrother markings, Maul was left solely red-skinned. Agonizing Sith Tatoos were applied personally by Darth Sidious in an attempt to cleanse Maul's mind.<ref name="Marked" /><ref name="JvS" /> Sidious later wrote in the ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]'' that he himself applied Maul's tattoos.<ref name="EGF">''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|The Essential Guide to the Force]]''</ref> The symbols on Maul's body showed both his Nightbrothers heritage,<ref name="SWCE" /> as well as his complete dedication to the dark side.<ref name="EGF" /> Maul's brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], was also tattoed in the same fashion as Maul, but his tattoos were brown.

The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], of the same era, bore Sith tattoos on his mouth and chin, even though he was never named a Sith Lord.<ref name="EGC" />

====One Sith====
{{Quote|Look at 'em, Cannon... Snarky, red-tatted gornts. I don't like 'em and I don't trust 'em.''"<br />"''Lords of the Empire, Storm.''"|[[Jae Akura|Jae "Stom" Akura]] and [[Brodie Coburn|Brodie "Cannon" Coburn]]|<ref name="Legacy44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>}}
During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[40 ABY/Legends|decades]] after the birth of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Sith continued to survive on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. One of them was [[Dician]], whose pale geometric-patterned tattoos on her cheeks stood out from normal black Sith tattoos. Her tattoos stood out in sharp relief on her dark skin.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

[[Vestara Khai]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], wore what appeared to be a black tattoo that went from between her eyes to the left side of her forehead.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' cover</ref> However, this was actually eye swirls that she carefully painted on every morning to draw attention away from a scar at the corner of her mouth.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

Many members of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]] wore red and black Sith tattoos all over their body.<ref>''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' - the red is specified in [[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref> Darth Krayt himself was tattooed long before he became a Sith. As a [[Human/Legends|Human]] raised among Tusken Raiders, he marked his face with black tattoos so that he, under his Tusken trappings, would not have to be human.<ref name="R59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref> His markings were ritual Tusken tattoos.<ref name="I113">{{InsiderCite|113|Dark Forces: The Villains of Star Wars|Dark Forces: The Villains of ''Star Wars''}}</ref> He also wore tattoos on his shoulders.<ref name="Siege" /> One of Krayt's two [[Hand (One Sith)|Hands]] was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Sith Lord [[Darth Talon]], whose tattoos were scribed by Krayt and earned in ritual combat.<ref name="L0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

===Skull Squadron===
[[Gunn Yage]], leader of [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]], and squadron members [[Brodie Coburn]] and [[Tev Rimon]], had their squadron symbol tattooed on their shoulder.<ref>[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]], design identified as Skull Squadron's symbol in [[Legacy (2006) 14|''Legacy'' (2006) 14]]</ref>

===Sluissi Padawans===
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] wore a braid behind the ear as a sign of their status; that is, those of them who had hair or fur. Padawans without hair would show their rank in other ways, and [[Sluissi]] Padawans could choose to bisect their left cheek with a facial tattoo.<ref name="JP" />

[[File:Nyrat-tattoo.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Nyrat Agira, a member of the Zealots of Psusan.]]

===Vurrha's Blood===
[[Vurrha's Blood]] was a criminal group lead by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Vurrha Chur]]. Their name derived from both the initiation ceremony where Vurrha would cut himself and smear his blood across the face of the new member, and the tattoos they wore - a red circle with a black teardrop inside.<ref name="UA">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref>

===Zealots of Psusan===
The [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]], female members of the cult [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Disciples of Psusan]], could be recognized by a spiritual tattoo of a black starburst on the abdomen, surrounding the navel.<ref>{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}} and ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> At least two designs existed: [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] wore a mark which was slightly more detailed than the design worn by [[Rosha Vess]]. Khaleen Hentz was adorned with other tattoos as well: Two triangles formed a diamond under her left eye, and a flower made up of black diamonds, dots and lines was tattooed on the left side of her back.<ref>{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}} and [[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]] ([[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]])</ref> The [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Breela]] had a belly tattoo very similar to the Zealots of Psusan, marking her as a possible member.<ref name="I89">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref>

==Notable people with individual tattoos==
===[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]]===
*The Zabrak [[Odon Anak]] wore a light red tattoo of a lightning bolt on her forehead and cheekbones, in addition to the traditional tattoos of her species.<ref name="UA" />

*The [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Breela]] had a belly tattoo very similar to the Zealots of Psusan, marking her as a possible member.<ref name="I89" />

*[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had strangely tattooed arms.<ref name="DB-Fett, Jango">{{DB|character|jangofett|Fett, Jango}}</ref>

*[[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] had reddish-brown tattoos on his face.<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> He got them while serving with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] band known as [[Marvasa's Marauders]] in the [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]].<ref name="Guide" />

*[[Gida Luroon]] wore black tattoos on the top of her left lekku and across her left eye.<ref name="Rendezvous at Ord Mantell">{{GamerCite|1|Rendezvous at Ord Mantell}}</ref>

*The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]-turned-bounty hunter [[Rav]] wore a pale, X-shaped tattoo over his left eye.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

*[[Tirog]] wore a gray tattoo over his right eye and cheek, as well as a red tattoo on his head and right arm.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

===[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]]===
{{Quote|They say he bulked himself up in captivity. And tattooed his name all over his body.|[[Hock Malsuum]], about his fellow clone trooper, [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]]|<ref name="DVatCoS2">[[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 2|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:HardcaseFull-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|Hardcase had tattoos on across his face and scalp]]
*[[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]] sported a red tattoo across his face. His helmet had a triangular design that reflected his tattoo.<ref name="Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

*[[Fives/Legends|Fives]] had a tattoo of a "5" on his right temple.<ref name="CWR">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>

*[[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] had blue stripes tattooed across his face and scalp, which matched a design painted on his [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}} and {{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}}</ref>

*[[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] sported dark tattoos on either side of his face, from the back of the neck to the cheeks.<ref name="CWR" />

*[[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] had a large [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cog on his helmet and tattooed across his face and head.<ref name="Deserter" />

*[[Jek/Legends|Jek]] had a tattoo which consisted of a circle and lines on the back of his neck.<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>

*While clone trooper [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]] was held in captivity on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] (for killing his [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] instructor), he tattooed his name all over his body, in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters.<ref name="DVatCoS2" />

*[[Kix/Legends|Kix]] had the phrase "A good [[Droid/Legends|droid]] is a [[Death/Legends|dead]] one" tattooed in Aurebesh on the left side of his head.<ref name="Deserter" />

*[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo's]] face sported a tattoo of his number: CC-8826, in Aurebesh.<ref name="SW-Secret Weapons - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep510|text="Secret Weapons" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>

*[[Rys/Legends|Rys]] had a tattoo on his neck and jaw.<ref name="Ambush" />

*[[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] had tattoo of the Aurebesh letter [[Senth/Legends|Senth]], or "S," above his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="CWCE" />

*Commander [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] was recognizable by a tattoo on the left side of his forehead, which resembled the number "53".<ref>{{TCW|The Gungan General}} (identified as Stone in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'') and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'')</ref>

*[[Tup/Legends|Tup]] sported a tear drop tattoo under his right eye. His helmet had a tear drop design that reflected his tattoo.<ref name="Umbara" />

===Force users===
*The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tavion Axmis]] wore patterns of purple tattoos on her arms and forehead, as well as under her eyes and on the bridge of her nose.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and expert [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], and the expert slicer [[Zakarisz Ghent]] both hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baroli/Legends|Baroli]],<ref name="EkrGhe">Ghent: ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'', Ekria: ''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref> and were distinguished by their blue hair and the same blue facial tattoos<ref name="GheEkr">Ekria: ''[[Reversal of Fortune]]'', Ghent: [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Heir to the Empire comic'']] and {{DB|character|ghent|Ghent, Zakarisz}}</ref>. It is not known whether their appearance was part of a culture, organization or sub-culture, or whether they were related.

*The [[near-Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fay]] had black lines tattooed on her left cheek and forehead.<ref name="Republic 53">[[Republic 53|''Republic'' 53]]</ref>

*Jedi Master [[Fy-Tor-Ana]] had a tattoo on her forehead. At the time she was hiding underneath the bedrock of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the facial mark had become faded.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Underworld">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>

*For Jerec, see entry for [[Tattoo/Legends#Sith Order|Sith Order]].

*The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]] had thin, black lines tattooed on his chin and on the sides of his nose.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

*The [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sarcev Quest]] had a purplish tattoo on the top of his bald head.<ref name="The Emperor's Pawns">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

*The Emperor's Hand and [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] had a tattoo of the [[Emperor's Reach]] on his left forearm, which signified his involvement with the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Emperor's Secret Order]].<ref>[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] and ''[[The Emperor's Pawns]]'' in [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]]</ref>

*The bald Dark Jedi [[Trenox]] had dark lines tattooed on his head.<ref name="Star Wars: The New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>

[[File:Jabba_tat.jpg|thumb|right|175px|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] arm tattoo]]
*The [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]<ref name="I122" /><ref name="SWE-Asajj Ventress">{{SWE|characters|asajjventress|Asajj Ventress}}</ref> Dark Jedi [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was distinguished by the black tattoos on her chalk-white skin. Six knife-shaped tattoos were arrayed on each side of her bald head, like daggers pointing at her ears, one for each of the twelve warlords she had killed after swearing their deaths.<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref><ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> However, on several occasions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was seen with different, wavy markings, and had apparently added tattoos to her jaw.<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)]]</ref> These markings were ritual tattoos.<ref name="CWCE" />

*[[Yuledan]], a Jedi of the [[New Jedi Order]], had red symbols tattooed on his chest.<ref name="Invasion: Rescues 2">[[Invasion: Rescues 2|''Invasion: Rescues'' 2]]</ref>

*The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Groola]] had a purple talon-shaped tattoo over each eye, as well as two bands of purple tattoos that went from his chin and down his chest and belly.<ref name="CCW" />

*The gangster [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] wore the symbol of [[Desilijic/Legends|his clan]] as a tattoo on his right arm.<ref>[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] (the ''right'' arm)</ref> The tattoo was made of [[yoro]] root pigment.<ref name="VD" /> Big Gizz, the leader of Jabba's [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang, wore a tattoo identical to Jabba's, on the same arm. Several other members of his gang did it so, as a symbol of their affiliation.<ref name="SEC">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Shadows of the Empire'' comic]]</ref>

But no - this is vanity, decoration, nothing more.|[[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Nom Anor]], commenting on his meeting with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Briika Jeban]]|<ref name="BF:APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>}}

The formerly meaningless symbol went on to become the flag for Nym's band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' and [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones|''Starfighter: Crossbones'']] (placement of tattoo).</ref>

*[[Diversity Alliance]] leader [[Nolaa Tarkona]] had her single lekku &ndash; the other one was missing &ndash; tattooed, and stoically endured the prolonged agony. Everyone who saw the Twi'lek woman's tattoos admired her endurance, which added to her power.<ref name="YJK" />

*The [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Lusubrin T'shkali]], also known as Brin, had a violet royal crest tattooed around his left eye, and silver sigils tattooed on his neck. He refused to discuss the significance of either set of markings.<ref name="WHSV" />
*[[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] had dark gray tattoos on her face and right arm.<ref name="Sabotage episode">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:Veed-tattoo.jpg|thumb|left|240px|[[Morlish Veed]] had a simple tattoo of Aurebesh letters on his arm]]

*[[Vreel]], a recruit of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], wore intricate tattoos on the side of his scalp.<ref name="You're in the Army Now!">{{JournalCite|2|You're in the Army Now!}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
One of the proposed designs for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] had him sporting a [[Wikipedia:mohawk|mohawk]] and a black tattoo on his right arm and shoulder,<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> but [[George Lucas]] thought it was too much.<ref name="DVD">[[Star Wars home video releases#Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' DVD]]: "Two Worlds', One Movie" web documentary</ref>

The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']] states that tattoos are part of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] culture, and describes the white facial markings of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as tattoos. This has been contradicted in other sources; the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' all establish that the facial markings of the Togruta are in fact natural pigments. Even so, during the production of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', Ahsoka's facial markings were designed as tattoos, according to ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. A conclusive answer has yet to be revealed.

In [[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]], a black tattoo erroneously appears on [[Fionah Ti]]'s shoulder in one panel. For the rest of the storyarc, the tattoo is missing.
